name: Tree view (categorized outline with search, filters, drag-and-drop)
description: A multi-level tree of branches and leaves for any outline: fold / unfold, search that highlights and keeps the path to every match open, filter chips, a meta column and a progress meter per branch, multi-select, context-menu targets and drag-and-drop through lib-dnd (before / after / into a branch). Harvested Oct 22 2026 from Walkthrough Studio's index.

parts.label: Search box
parts.description: Search the labels (and anything the app adds); matches are highlighted and their branches stay open.

parts.label: Filter chips
parts.description: Tappable chips that narrow the leaves (status, kind… the app names them).

parts.label: Branch meters
parts.description: A small progress meter on every branch (the framework's meter asset).

parts.label: Drag to rearrange
parts.description: Leaves and branches drag before / after / into a branch (needs lib-dnd).

params.label: Deleting by dropping on the trash can

parts.label: Multi-select
parts.description: Ctrl / Cmd + click adds leaves to a selection.

placeholders.note: Windowed rendering for very large trees — not built.
